note: Domains this catalog once linked that were later taken over by unrelated (gambling or spam) sites, or that lapsed so that anyone could register them. A taken-over domain can still answer HTTP 200, so a status-code link check cannot catch it. The build refuses any link to these hosts; an archived copy of the original page is linked instead.

entries.reason: Former address of ISCA's speech synthesis SIG; now serves a gambling site.
Redirects through about ten unrelated domains to a lottery and gambling page.
The domain lapsed and is no longer registered (it was offered for sale in 2021 and parked in 2023); 2018 archived copies are linked instead.
